dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, light-colored (white/cream) perimeters. The geometry transitions sharply from a dark charcoal exterior to a lighter interior, with most prominent rings displaying circular to slightly elliptical forms in the mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of interconnected high-intensity pixels along the upper dorsal ridge, forming an irregular lattice-like network. In contrast, the lateral region shows a lower density of discrete, isolated high-intensity annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct mid-lateral annuli form a scalene triangle. A primary geometric relationship is observed between the centroid of the large dorsal patch and a cluster of four mid-body rings, forming a roughly trapezoidal spatial arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, complex network of coalesced light markings is present along the entire visible dorsal ridge. A localized occlusion of the lower ventral-lateral region is caused by several vertical green features consistent with terrestrial vegetation.
